text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
choice_data_list: Are you short on sleep, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~ But I feel amazing! After all...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I rewatched races from when I was little! 
There was such huge cheering! It made my 
heart race—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... My adrenaline was going a 
hundred miles an hour... so I couldn't get 
any sleep...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria was so overwhelmed by the 
fever pitch of the crowd's cheers that she 
couldn't sleep well...
